# GainTrack

> Gym workout tracker for Android. Log workouts, log meals, hit PRs — with an AI coach and progress analytics. Exclusively on Android.

## About

GainTrack is a fitness tracking app for lifters, athletes and home-gym users, built by a solo developer. Core features: set/rep/weight workout logging, PR and streak tracking, progress analytics (volume trends, strength curves), a routine/program builder, meal logging with macro tracking, a 240-exercise library, plate calculator, and an AI coach (workout and meal analysis, form feedback) for Pro users. Available in 5 languages (English, Greek, German, French, Italian). No ads. Free tier + optional Pro subscription via in-app purchase.

- Platforms: Android only
- Rating on Google Play: 3.8 / 5
- Tagline: "Track workouts, log meals, hit PRs. Smart gym tracker with AI coach & progress."

## Pro tier

GainTrack Pro adds: AI coach (workout & meal analysis), unlimited routines (free tier keeps 3), advanced analytics & long-term trends, priority support.
